# SI 精選 / AI Agents Board

> The top AI agents, ranked weekly / 每週幫你挑出最好用的 AI 工具. A weekly ranking of AI agent tools by public signals such as GitHub stars, with who each tool is for and what it does. 每週 AI Agent 工具排行榜：依 GitHub 星數等公開訊號排名，並說明每個工具適合誰、能做什麼。

Ranking method: GitHub repositories related to AI agents, created in roughly the last 60 days, sorted by GitHub stars (popularity, not a quality test). Sponsored content is always labeled and never affects rankings.

## Latest issue (2026-11-02, last updated 2026-11-02)
- [English](https://aiagentsboard.com/issues/2026-11-02/) · [zh-Hant](https://aiagentsboard.com/zh/issues/2026-11-02/)

1. [yetone/magpie](https://github.com/yetone/magpie): Lets each agent run on another model (e.g. Claude Code on Kimi, Codex on DeepSeek), switched from the menu bar; a local gateway moves to your next account when a quota runs out.
2. [browser-use/jev-ultrafast](https://github.com/browser-use/jev-ultrafast): Give it a goal and the agent picks actions (click, type, select, scroll) from a table of page elements; the README cites a Google Flights search done in 7.1 seconds.
3. [wheresryan22/anatomy](https://github.com/wheresryan22/anatomy): A Claude skill (also Codex, OpenCode and others) that turns an idea into an interactive isometric figure (SVG, WebGL, 3D) built from many precise parts.
4. [deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype): A proactive coding agent for one GitHub repo: it listens to GitHub (optionally Feishu), takes work from allowed people, works in its own session and replies in the original thread, e.g. with a PR; a web panel shows what needs a person.
5. [zai-org/ZCode](https://github.com/zai-org/ZCode): An AI coding workbench with a desktop app, browser UI and terminal agent; the repo holds the client, backend and agent CLI source.
6. [Jakeschincariol/replica-skill](https://github.com/Jakeschincariol/replica-skill): Eleven Claude skills: reverse-engineer an app's screens and flows, rebuild, test, plan stack and database, wire auth and payments, brand and launch; it rebuilds features, never code, logos or content.
7. [Louis-CFM/coucou](https://github.com/Louis-CFM/coucou): A notch buddy: approve permissions, watch agents work, drop files, chat with Claude; v0.4 adds offline voice typing and call recording with transcripts.
8. [kaankiziltug/logo-design-skill](https://github.com/kaankiziltug/logo-design-skill): Takes an agent from brief to production SVG files and brand guidelines; includes a 1,400+ reference logo library and Python tools (16 px, one-colour, reversed tests, favicon export).
9. [Oldcircle/geo-sleuth](https://github.com/Oldcircle/geo-sleuth): An agent skill (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, etc.) that infers where a photo was taken and shows its reasoning; its description mentions OpenStreetMap and elevation skylines.
10. [wangzan101/Mika](https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika): A phone AI assistant: say what you need and it operates apps and the web on a hidden background screen until done, while you keep using your phone.
